scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: Big news: the city TV channel wants a report about our school… and Kili will be on TV!
scene.intro: Big news: the city TV channel wants a report about our school! Diego is delighted, obviously. He thinks documentaries are more interesting than cartoons; Kili strongly disagrees and says cartoons are clearly superior. They watch the programme together on a tiny screen and argue happily all afternoon. What kind of programmes do YOU like? Give your opinion and defend it!

data.text: On Thursday a real TV team came to our school. The presenter, Miss Vega, interviewed our head teacher first — he was so nervous that he said his own name wrong! Then they filmed the science room, where Maya showed her volcano experiment. The best moment was in the playground: Kili flew down and landed on the camera! Everybody laughed, and the camera operator gave him a biscuit. The report will be on channel nine on Sunday, after the eight o'clock news.

Don't press the red button before the cameras are ready! … Diego: Lunch with the TV team: the cook is making her famous fish soup. … Diego: And the big final: Kili flies over the playground with the school flag. … Diego: Kili, please: this time, do NOT land on the camera!
